story: You lean over the Wellhead Grid — two pairs of timber beams crossed into a square frame — and drop a pebble through the opening; a cold echo splashes far below: this is the WELL.
reading_story: The white-bearded Sage lowers his long beard into the WELL like a rope, hauling up a dripping bucket of icy water.

story: UNDERTAKE: a Stepladder stands atop a giant stop sign laid flat as its launch pad — the stop holds firm underfoot while rung after rung climbs toward an unbuilt skyscraper sketched in the clouds.
reading_story: Key the locksmith rattles one clipped "kee" at the padlocked construction gate — it springs open, and he strides in, first to UNDERTAKE the giant project.
issues: Minor: 'unbuilt skyscraper sketched in the clouds' is semi-abstract; a concrete half-built structure would image more sharply.
Minor: 'rung after rung climbs' has the ladder self-extending — poetic but slightly muddies the static A-frame persona (not a cognitive-ability violation).

story: At the left edge of a boot-shaped vineyard, Scarecrow watches Rake Hand drag the soil while Lightning Bolt cracks straight down through its tines — the scorched furrows spell ITALY.
reading_story: Mr. Eaton bites into pizza in ITALY, squealing a sharp "ee!" as the molten cheese burns his tongue.

story: At the field's left edge the Scarecrow stands stiff, straw arms piled with the farmer's rake, seed bag, and hat — it can't plow, but it holds everything: the perfect ASSISTANT.
reading_story: Sah answers every order with one clipped "sa!" — the tireless ASSISTANT who has fetched the tea before you finish asking.
issues: Minor: in reading_story the keyword ASSISTANT is followed by a trailing relative clause ('who has fetched the tea...'), slightly softening the end placement — still the payoff of the dash clause, so gate 4 passes.
Note (positive): 'field's left edge' doubles as a 左 phonetic anchor and matches the Scarecrow persona image verbatim — keep it.

story: The Scarecrow stands stiff at the field's left edge, the Setting-Sun Cage hung on its outstretched arm; the trapped red sun blazes through the bars like a priceless gem — sheer VALUE.
reading_story: Cabbie Carr never haggles; he just taps his ticking meter: "This machine alone decides the VALUE of your ride."
issues: Keyword payoff relies on a simile ('like a priceless gem') rather than a physically staged stake demonstrating value — slightly weakens imageability, non-gating
'sheer VALUE' ending shape is common across the price-family neighbors (値, 評価 kanji); the visual carries the distinctiveness

story: At the field's left edge the Scarecrow spreads its stiff arms; beside it a giant Open Mouth, speared atop the Tree, screams nonstop — one silent, one shrieking, together they PROTECT the field.
reading_story: Hoth plants himself in the doorway, arms crossed, and grunts one clipped syllable: "I PROTECT this house."

story: DISCIPLINE: a Lightning Bolt cracks down beside the stiff Scarecrow; on the right the Cracking Whip snaps at its back until its straw fingers rake three flawless Comb Streaks into the ground below.
reading_story: Every dawn the cobbler hammers his Shoe with monkish DISCIPLINE — same bench, same hundred strikes, never one missed.
issues: Lightning Bolt (｜) is present but causally inert — it 'cracks down beside' the scene without driving the action, slightly weakening imageability (minor, non-gating).

story: At the left edge of the field, the Scarecrow does chin-ups on its own pole, straw arms pumping, not one rotten straw in its body — unmistakably HEALTHY.
reading_story: Ken the plastic doll jogs by in tiny shorts, flexing his seamed arms: "Stay HEALTHY like me!"

story: SPONSOR of today's stunt: the Scarecrow at the field's left edge, banknotes pinned all over its straw, arms outstretched toward Stumpy Sparrow, who staggers past balancing snow-capped Mountain Peak on its head.
reading_story: Cy fires a fastball; stitched across his jersey in huge letters is the name of his SPONSOR.
issues: Minor: keyword link relies on inferring sponsorship from banknotes pinned to the Scarecrow plus the word 'stunt' — one small inferential step, acceptable.
Minor: two simultaneous focal actions (Scarecrow's outstretched arms, Sparrow balancing the mountain) slightly split visual attention.

story: The Scarecrow guards his buried Cowrie Shell: Mound of Soil heaped over it, Pot Lid clamped on top — yet the shell's Watching Eye glares through the dirt, Wishbone legs kicking. Treasure pawned against his DEBT.
reading_story: Cy owes the ballpark: each fastball Cy hurls knocks one coin off his DEBT, so he pitches until his arm hangs limp.
issues: Minor: the payoff 'Treasure pawned against his DEBT' is conceptual rather than imaged — no lender or pawnshop appears in the scene, so the debt link rests on the word 'pawned' alone.

Minor: reading_story keyword DEBT sits mid-sentence (word 14/22) with a trailing clause; passes per corpus precedent (井, 佐) since strict start/end placement gates the meaning story, and 'Cy owes' fronts the concept at the start.
Minor: reuses the Scarecrow-guarding-the-field frame already used for 佐 (ASSISTANT); the burial-mound staging keeps the scenes separable but watch for further Scarecrow guard scenes.
Note (positive): staging Watching Eye and Wishbone as the shell's eye and legs mirrors 貝 = 目 + ハ, and the lid/soil-over-shell stack matches the vertical layout of 責.

story: Scarecrow stands stiff at the left of the worksite; beside him a Stepladder perches on Twin Pillars, the Sun blazes beneath them, and Sand Trickle sifts at the bottom — every object here is his COLLEAGUE.
reading_story: Detective Ryo interrogates the whole office; every suspect's alibi is the same: "Ask my COLLEAGUE." Ryo groans — colleagues covering colleagues.
issues: Evidence: all gates pass — components: 'Scarecrow' / 'Stepladder' / 'Twin Pillars' / 'Sun' / 'Sand Trickle' all named; no phantoms ('worksite' is scenery); reading actor 'Detective Ryo' present and matches hardboiled-detective persona; keyword COLLEAGUE at end of both stories; ~35 and ~22 words.
Minor: 'the Sun blazes beneath them' is spatially hard to visualize (a sun below a ladder) even if it mirrors glyph layout — costs imageability.
Minor: meaning story is a static inventory of objects; COLLEAGUE arrives as a label, not as something the scene enacts, so the keyword binding is verbal rather than visual.

Minor interference risk: 'objects gathered = colleagues' is a generic frame; the ironic twist (his colleagues are all things, echoing the ⺅-as-thing Scarecrow) is what keeps it distinct from 寮/療/瞭 — preserve that twist in any edit.

story: Pinned high, the Wanted Poster shivers as the Guillotine Blade along its right edge drops in tiny strokes, shaving paper curls off the sketched face until only a splinter remains: WHITTLE.
reading_story: Awaiting trial, Sacco does nothing but WHITTLE — pale shavings pile around his boots as one more wooden spoon takes shape.
issues: Minor coherence seam: 'only a splinter remains' applies a wood image to a paper poster (non-gating)
Reading story keyword is clause-final (word 7 of 20) rather than literally first word; still reads as start placement, not buried

story: A lone Guillotine Blade stands at the right edge of an empty world. It drops — the first cut ever made — and from that fresh wound, light, rivers, and life ORIGINATE.
reading_story: Sosa steps to the plate shouting "Watch where legends ORIGINATE!" — his long, slow swing cracks the very first home run into orbit.
issues: Minor: payoff imagery ('light, rivers, and life') is a diffuse burst rather than one concrete object, slightly softening imageability at the keyword moment — not blocking.

story: Bean Sprouts stand rigidly upright atop the Rock Overhang while a daring recruit does push-ups in the hollow beneath; not one sprout bends in the gale. Everything about this cliff is STERN.
reading_story: Drill instructor Glenn inspects your bunk with a white glove; one speck of dust and his face turns STERN — he barks until the walls shake.
issues: Minor: meaning-story payoff line tells the keyword ('Everything about this cliff is STERN') rather than showing it — acceptable but slightly weaker than an enacted payoff.
Minor: reading story places STERN before a short trailing clause ('he barks until the walls shake'); still the clear payoff, not buried, so gate 4 passes.

story: A Meat Hook curls down the right edge; inside its frame hangs a flat Horizon Line, and beneath, an Open Mouth bellows "Action! Cut!" — that bossy mouth is the DIRECTOR.
reading_story: The Sheriff storms the film set, badge flashing: "Round here, I'm the DIRECTOR now" — one clipped "shi!" and the whole crew freezes.

story: War Helmet sits squarely on top of Open Mouth. The mouth shouts joyful congratulations up into the empty steel, which amplifies the cheer skyward — GOOD LUCK!
reading_story: Kitch scratches lottery ticket after ticket — every single one a winner. "GOOD LUCK just sticks to me," Kitch shrugs.

story: Four Open Mouths gape at the corners of the table; the Starfish sprawled in the middle stretches one arm into each, scooping and scrubbing them clean — a living UTENSIL.
reading_story: Key jimmies open the locked kitchen drawer — inside, every UTENSIL is chained down, each spoon and fork wearing its own tiny padlock.
issues: Minor (non-gating): in reading_story the keyword UTENSIL sits mid-sentence rather than at start/end; acceptable because the closing image (padlocked spoons and forks) is itself the utensil payoff, but an end-positioned keyword would be cleaner.
Minor: meaning story stacks two actions ('scooping and scrubbing') — one verb would sharpen the single snapshot rubric item 7/9 favors.

story: On the left, pure happiness glows; from the right the Luggage Tag Cane hooks it, paper tag fluttering, and no amount of tugging can pry that curled handle loose — TENACIOUS.
reading_story: Schitt grips his motel keys, TENACIOUS — bailiffs yank, twist, pry, but his white-knuckled fist never opens.

story: On the Mound of Soil the Wishbone stands, split legs braced; across its tips lies the Horizon Line, dead level, and the Candy Tin balances on top — a perfect FOUNDATION.
reading_story: Key the locksmith kneels, tapping his single key against the fresh FOUNDATION — one clipped "kee!" — checking the concrete is solid before any door goes up.
issues: Reading story places FOUNDATION mid-sentence rather than at start or end; meaning-story placement (end) passes the gate, but end placement in both stories would be stronger.
Horizon Line is handled as a rigid beam laid across the wishbone tips, which reifies the actor's horizon image into a carryable object — a slight imageability stretch.

story: Viewed from above, the Rice-Paddy Grid is the infield; Frost Beads sparkle along its frozen baselines, and beneath it the Mound of Soil has been heaped into four corner BASES.
reading_story: Louie rounds the BASES at dawn, cleats crunching frost, the whole stadium chanting "Lou-ie! Lou-ie!" as he slides home.
issues: Minor: a single Mound of Soil heaped into four corner bases is a slight one-to-many stretch, though physically plausible and not gate-failing

story: DEMOLITION! At the Plus-Sign Crossroads, a Fishing Net drops over the Hanger Kimono below and rips it down; splintered hanger and torn silk pile against the Mound of Soil alongside.
reading_story: Kai surfs a wave straight through the condemned pier, his board smashing pilings apart — the cheapest DEMOLITION crew ever hired.
issues: Minor (non-gating): 十 appears only as the scene's location ('At the Plus-Sign Crossroads') rather than encoding its top-of-right-side position — spatial hint for 十 is weak.
Minor (non-gating): reading story invents scenery (condemned pier, pilings) — allowed since reading stories aren't component-bound, but keeps it from reinforcing the glyph.

story: A GENTLEMAN stands ramrod-straight: shoulders spread wide as the long top stroke, spine one rigid vertical, feet planted on the short bottom line — shoulders broader than his stance.
reading_story: The Sheriff gives one clipped nod; the town's GENTLEMAN nods back just as crisply — two upright men, no words wasted.

story: The Hourglass stands alone on a low pedestal, sand streaming from top bulb to bottom, cinching its pinched glass waist — every falling grain sculpting that perfect FIGURE.
reading_story: At dusk the Sheriff freezes: a lone FIGURE stands silhouetted at the far end of the dusty street.
issues: Minor: in reading_story the keyword FIGURE sits mid-clause ("a lone FIGURE stands silhouetted at the far end of the dusty street") rather than as the terminal payoff word; still reads as the payoff, so not a gate failure.
Minor: the main story is static — the only motion is falling sand — which slightly caps imageability.

story: Beneath the Thatched House's peaked roof, a Horizon Line hangs like a banner rail; under it the Horizon Sunrise bursts through the doorway, gilding every wall — dawn itself rising to PROCLAIM.
reading_story: On the podium, Senna seizes the microphone from the announcer to PROCLAIM his own victory, champagne spraying over the crowd.
issues: Minor: 'dawn itself rising to PROCLAIM' is a slightly abstract payoff — no audience or spoken act; a concrete proclamation beat would image harder.
Minor: the Horizon Sunrise 'bursts through the doorway' while the scene is staged beneath the roof — slight inside/outside tension, though it reads as ordinary light-motion, not a persona violation.

story: Beneath the Thatched House's sloping eaves, a giant spine stands bolted upright, vertebra stacked on vertebra as the sacred pillar; pilgrims clap twice and bow to the bones — the SHINTO SHRINE.
reading_story: Governor Cuomo bows stiffly at the SHINTO SHRINE, tossing a coin and clapping twice, praying for one more term.
issues: Minor (non-gating): in the reading_story the keyword SHINTO SHRINE sits mid-clause rather than at the very start or end, though it directly follows the reading actor.

story: A Thatched House drops like a lid over the Mountain Peak; the one certain thing hidden between roof and summit is buried in SECRECY.
reading_story: Mitter seals his lips with wax; interrogators pry for hours, but Mitter's SECRECY never cracks.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): 'the one certain thing' is abstract and unpicturable — unavoidable since 必 has no actor persona, but it weakens the central hidden object of the scene.
Minor (non-blocking): 'house conceals X' is a frequent 宀 pattern; the mountain-capping scale inversion mitigates but does not eliminate neighbor-interference risk with other 宀 kanji.

story: Under the peaked roof of the Thatched House, farmers shuffle forward one turn at a time, each kneeling on the packed earth to plead their case before the JUDGE.
reading_story: Shinn the night bartender raps his cocktail shaker on the bar like a gavel: in every last-call dispute, Shinn is the JUDGE.

story: TAKE POSITION! At the capital's right flank, the Lunging Fencer freezes mid-lunge, back leg sweeping wide, mole gleaming on his raised shoulder — the city's champion claims his post.
reading_story: The cobbler nails his Shoe to the palace floor, marking the exact spot where the new minister must TAKE POSITION — step in, and the job is yours.

story: Under the Draped Cloak's slack canopy, an Iron Staple pins the Hanger Kimono's collar flat to the floor; pry the staple free and the silk sleeves spring wide open — UNFOLD.
reading_story: Detective Tennison snaps open her case file and watches the folded map of the crime scene UNFOLD across the desk.
issues: Non-blocking: 'slack canopy' mildly extends the Draped Cloak persona (registry image has it slumped over a chair); acceptable as ordinary physical draping but the canopy adds little to the core image.

story: PROMONTORY: Mountain Peak thrusts out into the sea, and clinging to its right flank a Bobblehead Totem wobbles above the surf, lopsided head nodding toward the horizon with every crashing wave.
reading_story: Key, the clipped locksmith, stands at the very tip of the PROMONTORY, locking the lighthouse door with one crisp click — "kee!"

story: Mountain Peak balances its triple summit on two Full Moons wedged beneath; the silver discs roll apart, and with a groan the whole mountain CRUMBLES.
reading_story: Ho lands his sleigh on a sugar cliff; one booming "Ho-ho-ho!" and the whole cliff CRUMBLES beneath his reindeer.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): reading story's crumbling-cliff imagery could mildly interfere with 崖 (cliff)-family mnemonics; the Ho/sleigh anchor keeps it distinct enough.
Strength worth keeping: 'two Full Moons wedged beneath' the mountain encodes the actual 山-over-朋 (月+月) layout — high spatial fidelity.

story: Early morning at the Plus-Sign Crossroads: a Stepladder teeters on the tip of a swaying Antenna Mast, and the whole shaky tower leans against one immovable TREE TRUNK.
reading_story: Khan reins in his warhorse and lashes it to a lone TREE TRUNK on the steppe — nothing else out here is strong enough to hold it.
issues: Minor: reading story keyword is followed by a trailing clause ('nothing else out here is strong enough to hold it') — still lands as the payoff since the clause points back at the trunk, but the meaning story's clean final-position placement is stronger.
Minor: '早' is conveyed only as the time framing 'Early morning' (acceptable since it has no actor, but it is the least visual element of the scene).
Minor: Antenna Mast persona image says 'planted upright on a roof'; here it stands at a crossroads and sways — ordinary physical variation, not a persona contradiction.

story: Beneath the Cliff Awning, the Fistful of Tail holds its catch fast while Rake Hand calmly combs the loose tail-hairs; below, the Tsunami Wave breaks into soft warm spray — sheltered, secured, at EASE.
reading_story: Coe laps the whole Olympic field at a gentle jog, waving to the crowd, and crosses the finish line with insulting EASE.

story: Under the Cliff Awning, Splayed Snowshoes trample the Horizon Line down onto the Wishing-Well Legs, snapping them — across the condemned shelter's slanted roof drips one painted word: ABOLISH.
reading_story: Hyde kicks down parliament's doors at midnight, shredding laws with clawed hands and snarling one clipped word: ABOLISH.
issues: Minor: Horizon Line (defined as a distant desert horizon) is used as a physically trampled bar — acceptable object-handling but costs a translation step in visualization.
Minor: two focal images (crushing/snapping scene plus dripping painted word) slightly split attention, though they cohere as one condemned-shelter tableau.

story: A pipe gushes skyward; from beneath, Cupped Palms hoist the Sealed Clam-Locket to cap the spout — it clamps down tight, and the roaring water stops dead: a perfect VALVE.
reading_story: Big Ben stops chiming; a plumber climbs the tower and finds Ben's steam VALVE stuck shut — one twist and the great bell booms again.
issues: Non-blocking: reading story contains single-word overlaps 'steam' (actor 'Steam Vapor' 气) and 'great bell' (actor 'Bronze Temple Bell' 寺); neither is an exact persona-phrase collision per the 1175ef3 phantom-fix class, and both are intrinsic to the Big Ben persona setting.

story: A postcard-perfect scenery glows in full sun; along its right edge, Comb Streaks rakes three slanting lines, and every raked groove kills the light, smearing a long dark SHADOW.
reading_story: At sunset Abe cannot outrun his own SHADOW — it stretches long and dark ahead of his every stride.

story: Beside the Forked Footpath stand the Twin Pillars; wedged beneath their shared ledge, the Fabric Roll unspools its strip along whichever way the trail bends, hugging every turn — cloth made to OBEY.
reading_story: Juno strides ahead, and her fan-tailed peacocks fall into single file behind her — everything must OBEY the queen.
issues: Minor: cloth 'hugging every turn' while the roll stays wedged under the ledge requires a beat to visualize (non-blocking)
Minor: peacocks in reading_story are an embellishment beyond the registry note, though consistent with the Juno persona (non-blocking)

story: Down at the bottom of your chest, your heart strains upward against your ribs, pounding in one fixed direction like a compass needle — that single unwavering pull is INTENTION.
reading_story: The Sheriff rides into town at dawn, hand hovering over his holster, with one clipped INTENTION: clean this place up.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): in the reading story the keyword is followed by a trailing clause ("INTENTION: clean this place up"), slightly softening the payoff, though it is still not buried.
Minor (non-blocking): main-story imagery is partly kinesthetic (internal chest sensation); the compass-needle simile is what carries the visual — keep it if the story is ever edited.

story: Beneath the Cliff Awning a huge heart hangs from the slanted roof. Press it like a doorbell — it thuds back one warm answering beat. That's how you APPLY here.
reading_story: Keeper Owen never opens his gate unless you APPLY: ring his bell and his long "Ooooh!" booms back in answer.
issues: Non-gating: keyword payoff is asserted ('That's how you APPLY here') rather than dramatized as an act of applying
Non-gating: in reading_story the keyword appears mid-sentence, though the placement gate is satisfied by the meaning story's end placement

story: Under the Barbed Pike's hooked blade, the Open Mouth croons honeyed promises; the heart lying below floats up entranced, straight onto the hidden spur — BEGUILE.
reading_story: Walker treks a thousand miles because one roadside smile managed to BEGUILE him; he circles the same tent all night, boots worn through.
issues: Minor: in reading_story the keyword BEGUILE is mid-story with a trailing clause ('he circles the same tent all night...'); corpus convention applies the start/end gate to the main story only, so gate 4 passes, but a tighter end placement would be stronger.
Minor: 'honeyed promises' is auditory/semi-abstract; a visible lure (e.g. dripping honey) would image more sharply.
Note (positive): spatial staging is faithful — Mouth under the Pike's blade, heart below floating up matches the 或-over-心 layout of 惑.

story: Glowing ability balances on top of a huge beating heart; every heartbeat jolts it into chin-up swagger or sulky slump. The angle the heart leaves it at is ATTITUDE.
reading_story: Ty spikes into second base and glares down the umpire — nobody recalls the stats, everyone recalls Ty's ATTITUDE.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): 'glowing ability' is an abstract protagonist — 能 has no actor/image, so learners must visualize an amorphous glow; the physical staging (balancing on the beating heart, swagger/slump postures) compensates.
Minor (non-blocking): Ty Cobb's spiking scene is mildly violent but within ordinary baseball-history bounds; no safety concern.

story: Inside the Thatched House, a Pot Lid clamps down on a Mound of Soil; beneath them a Fishing Net stretches flat, pinning a beating heart — carved into that trapped heart is the CONSTITUTION.
reading_story: Ken the plastic doll stands stiff on a podium, one rigid arm raised, squeakily swearing to defend the CONSTITUTION.
issues: Minor: five stacked elements form two loosely coupled sub-scenes (Pot Lid on Soil vs. Net pinning heart), slightly raising visualization load — not gating.
Minor: 心-bottom 'trapped/pressed heart' imagery recurs across the corpus; the 'constitution carved into the heart' detail mitigates interference risk.

story: A hand clenches the Meat Hook dangling at its wrist and swings the Barbed Pike on its right, slashing at anyone who reaches for what is "mine" — pure EGO.
reading_story: Garr guns her growling engine outside the theater, drowning out every other star — her EGO demands the loudest entrance.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): 'clenches the Meat Hook dangling at its wrist' is slightly ambiguous to visualize — is the hook gripped in the hand or hanging from the wrist? Consider 'grips the Meat Hook hanging at its wrist' for a cleaner image.

story: The Lone Barn Shutter creaks on its single hinge; knotted to its bottom corner, sweeping arcs in the doorway dust with every gust, swings a fat crimson TASSEL.
reading_story: Bowie struts onstage twirling a glittering TASSEL on his microphone stand, flinging sparkles over the front row.
issues: Minor: in reading_story the keyword TASSEL is mid-sentence with a trailing clause ('flinging sparkles over the front row') rather than the final payoff — consistent with Minor-only precedent (佐), meaning story placement is clean.

story: CRITICISM: at the left edge, the Grabber Claw lowers onto a fresh manuscript, snatches it up, and slaps it down again and again, striking red gouges through every line.
reading_story: Every time the CRITICISM lands, Hee lets out one clipped "hee!" — a giggle per insult.
issues: Minor (non-gating): slap/strike action overlaps conceptually with other 扌 kanji such as 打 'strike'; the gouged-manuscript prop carries the distinctiveness, so keep it prominent in any edit.

story: The Grabber Claw dives from the left at the Pot Lid perched on the Low Stool; the lid clamps down tight, the stool trips its fingers — every snatch fails: DEFY.
reading_story: Officials rope off the track, but Coe vaults the rope mid-stride and keeps running — born to DEFY.
issues: Minor: 'the stool trips its fingers' is physically slightly awkward (a stool tripping a claw's fingers), though consistent with the Low Stool's trip-over persona and still imageable — not gating.

story: EXPAND: the Grabber Claw hooks the Cliff Awning's edge and hauls it wider and wider, stretching the slanted roof until the tiny Sealed Clam-Locket huddled beneath sits inside a vast, echoing shelter.
reading_story: Knuckles winds up one punch; on impact his boxing glove balloons, forced to EXPAND until it fills the whole ring.
issues: Advisory (non-blocking): closing image (vast shelter over the Clam-Locket) is near-identical to the likely end-state of 広 'wide' (广+厶); the Grabber Claw actively hauling is the sole discriminator — keep that action foregrounded in any edit.

story: RAISE! A hand punches up from the dirt, hoisting a Wishbone whose legs spring apart; atop it, Bean Sprouts stretch taller and taller as the hand lifts them all skyward.
reading_story: At the auction, Cole is fastest to RAISE his paddle — the auctioneer only ever hears Cole's bid.

story: The Grabber Claw descends from the left toward Stumpy Sparrow, perched fat and motionless on her wire. Will those three fingers close on feathers or on empty air? Pure CONJECTURE.
reading_story: Swee feeds the machine another coin, pointing: "It grabs dead center this time!" Every CONJECTURE costs him a quarter, and the prize never drops.
issues: Minor: reading-story keyword is at the start of the final sentence but followed by a trailing clause ('...costs him a quarter, and the prize never drops') — payoff still lands, not gating.

story: Lightning Bolt cracks straight down through the Horizon Line and both Railway Tracks, stopping just above the Sun. From the left, Grabber Claw plucks that Sun free and swings it away — SET ASIDE for later.
reading_story: Saul Goodman slides your case file to the desk's far corner: "SET ASIDE for now — I'll call you."
issues: Non-blocking: Grabber Claw removes the Sun from the scene, but 日 stays inside the glyph — slight spatial-fidelity softness (rubric item 11), acceptable because the removal IS the keyword payoff.
Non-blocking: the bolt/horizon/tracks-over-sun tableau will repeat across 昔-family kanji (借, 錯, 惜); distinctiveness rests on the claw-sets-sun-aside action, which carries it here.

story: The Grabber Claw dips from the left, pinches the blazing Sun like a giant engagement ring, and holds it high while the Fabric Roll unspools a white aisle below — lowering it to PROPOSE.
reading_story: Tay rehearses all week; at last she kneels, holds out the ring, and finally dares to PROPOSE.
issues: Minor coherence wobble: claw 'holds it high' then is 'lowering it' in the same beat — non-blocking, but the final frame's motion is slightly contradictory.

story: At the arcade's left edge, the Grabber Claw descends over a tray of ripe strawberries, ignores the plush prizes, and closes just two metal fingertips on one tiny stem — a perfect PINCH.
reading_story: Tekker taps the joystick once — "Don't grab, PINCH!" — and the claw lifts the prize by a single thread.

story: WITHDRAW! On the left the Grabber Claw drops and plucks up the recruit the army hoped to bring up, while on the right the Cracking Whip snaps, lashing every straggler into retreat.
reading_story: Tetsuo mutates, flesh engulfing the stadium; the army screams WITHDRAW and every tank rolls back out of Neo-Tokyo.

story: AGGRESSION incarnate: from the right, the Cracking Whip snaps down again and again, its lash raking red stripes across a cowering target, driving it forward under relentless attack.
reading_story: Final lap: Coe surges past with sheer AGGRESSION, elbows out, spikes flashing, attacking every rival on the bend.
issues: Distinctiveness is only adequate: the story is essentially the Cracking Whip's default persona behavior (rap and drive into action) aimed at a generic unnamed 'cowering target', which may interfere with other 攵-family kanji stories; a more specific target/anchor would sharpen it.

story: From the right, the Cracking Whip snaps down again and again, each stinging lash rapping out the same demand from the empty air: no excuses — give me the REASON.
reading_story: In her atelier, Coco snips away every ribbon that cannot justify itself: "Elegance demands a REASON for everything."
issues: Whip 'rapping out a demand' voices speech — borderline anthropomorphism, though within its rap-and-drive persona (non-blocking)
Lash strikes 'empty air': no concrete target in the scene, which caps imageability
Verbal/auditory hook ('no excuses — give me the REASON') rather than a distinct visual scene; moderate interference risk with other 攵 (Cracking Whip) stories

story: The Tsunami Wave curls over, about to swallow the tiny Ink Droplet clinging to its crest. From the right the Cracking Whip snaps out, coils around the droplet, and yanks it clear — a RESCUE.
reading_story: Cuomo wades before the cameras, hauls a stranded family into his boat, and grins: every channel replays the Cuomo RESCUE on loop.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): rescuing a water droplet from a wave is conceptually water-from-water; the ink-black droplet color is what keeps the image legible — preserve that detail in any edit.
Minor (non-blocking): the wave+droplet pair is shared with other 求-family kanji, so distinctiveness rests entirely on the whip-rescue action.

story: On the left a sloppy bundle of sticks sprawls loose; from the right the Cracking Whip lashes down, and every stick leaps into neat, straight ranks — ORGANIZE.
reading_story: The white-bearded Sage strokes his beard, and cluttered scrolls glide onto their shelves — to ORGANIZE anything, summon the Sage.
issues: Minor: reading story's gliding-scroll image is softer than the main story; sage-consistent, not gating
Minor: whip-imposes-order motif is shared across 攵 kanji (e.g. 政); stick-bundle anchor mitigates collision risk

story: Above the bare Tree, the Cracking Whip snaps down, driving the muddy Trailing Footprint across a parchment nailed to the topmost branch — each lash underlining one numbered clause of the ARTICLE.

reading_story: Hugo grades everything — sunsets, soups, strangers' hats — scribbling stars in his notebook; nothing escapes his need to EVALUATE.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): five actors in one frame is dense; the keyword payoff rests entirely on the '9.5' scoring gag, which works but leaves Horizon Line and Railway Tracks as passive scenery.

story: SOLICIT: the Speech Bubble floats door to door, stacked lines rearranged into a begging plea, tail jabbing at each resident until someone drops a coin through its lid.
reading_story: The white-bearded Sage must SOLICIT alms too: he bows, bowl out, stretching every begged syllable as looong as his beard.
issues: Minor: 'stacked lines rearranged into a begging plea' is weakly visual (text rearranging is hard to picture); the surrounding physical action carries the image.
Minor: begging/alms framing could mildly interfere with other request/beg kanji (e.g. 求, 乞, 頼) if their mnemonics also stage begging; the coin-through-lid detail mitigates this.

story: On the shore a giant leg rises as the Tsunami Wave curls over the setting Sun; the leg stamps the crest flat onto the Sun — one thunderous, spray-bursting STEP.
reading_story: Onstage, Tone raps while stomping his boot on the beat — every STEP shakes the arena floor.
issues: Minor persona drift: Sun's registry image specifies a 'bright round midday sun blazing in a clear sky' but the story stages 'the setting Sun' — physical staging only, not gate-failing, but consider changing 'setting' to 'blazing' for exact persona match.
Reading story keyword placement: 'every STEP shakes the arena floor' leaves STEP one clause before the end rather than as the final payoff word; acceptable but weaker than the main story's ending.

story: The rolling Cartwheel carries a Mound of Soil heaped on its hub; the Barbed Pike slants overhead from the right, its hooked spur snagging the sprout-marker to hold everything steady for the RIDE.
reading_story: Cy refuses cabs; he pitches himself onto every passing wagon, yelling "Best RIDE in the league!"
issues: Minor: soil heaped on a rolling wheel's hub is slightly awkward physics — vivid but takes a beat to picture
Minor: in the reading story RIDE sits inside the final exclamation rather than as the literal last word, though it is still the payoff
Watch-item: 'Barbed Pike overhead' recurs across the 𢦏 family (栽/裁/哉/戴) — the soil-riding-the-wheel core must carry the distinction

story: URGE — the Conveyor Belt under your heels lurches faster and faster, rubber humming hot, shoving you helplessly forward down the road; you can't step off, can't slow it, only stumble onward.
reading_story: A Hacker hunches over the keyboard, countdown flashing red; every alarm is an URGE to type faster before the system locks.
issues: Distinctiveness borderline: belt-acceleration imagery overlaps 追 (N3 'chase': 'Conveyor Belt speeds up beneath them') and 速 (N3 'quick': belt whips fast down the road); 迫 has no second component actor to anchor it, relying solely on the second-person helpless framing ('can't step off, can't slow it') to differentiate URGE from CHASE/QUICK.
Phonetic 白 is unrepresented in the meaning story (by design, covered via reading actor Hacker/はく), so nothing in the story cues the 白 half of the glyph for recognition.

story: On the Conveyor Belt rolling forward, the Rake Hand claws down from above, the Tsunami Wave crashes below, and caught between them the Fistful of Tail snaps shut on the fleeing beast — APPREHEND.
reading_story: Ty slides for second, spikes high — police storm the diamond and APPREHEND Ty mid-slide, cuffing baseball's dirtiest player.
issues: Minor: scene carries five entities (four actors + beast) because the record supplies both composite 隶 and its sub-parts ヨ/水, making Rake Hand and Tsunami Wave partially redundant with Fistful of Tail's own image — crowds the tableau but coverage is mandatory, so not a candidate defect.
Minor: in reading_story the keyword APPREHEND is the payoff verb but not the literal final word ('cuffing baseball's dirtiest player' trails it); acceptable, meaning story placement is clean.

story: DISPATCH: you stand at the exact middle of the sky, drop past the flat Horizon Line into the Open Mouth below, and it spits you onto the Conveyor Belt, which carries you steadily off to your posting.
reading_story: Ken, the plastic doll, is sealed in a box stamped DISPATCH — molded smile pressed to the little window — and shipped overseas.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): 'you stand at the exact middle of the sky' is a weakly picturable opening pose; a concrete anchor (e.g. dangling mid-sky from nothing) would sharpen imageability.

story: A dying man sets everything precious he owns onto the Conveyor Belt beneath it; it carries the treasure steadily down the road to his grandchildren — his way to BEQUEATH it all.
reading_story: Mr. Eaton snaps open the will with a clipped "ee!" and declares, "I hereby BEQUEATH everything!"
issues: Minor wording: 'onto the Conveyor Belt beneath it' — pronoun 'it' has no clear antecedent (appears to refer to the glyph); 'beneath him' would read cleaner. Non-gating.
'Everything precious he owns' is a category rather than a single crisp object, slightly softening imageability (kept at 4, not 5).

story: On the Conveyor Belt rides the Draped Cloak, drooped over the Open Mouth tucked beneath its hem; from the right the Chili Needle stabs — the belt rolls them just out of reach. AVOID!
reading_story: Every time you turn, Hee darts away with a clipped "hee!" — the giggler is impossible to catch, a master of AVOID.

story: The Falling Katana slashes down onto the Railway Tracks, severing both rails; the Staircase Curb leans in from the right, its stone steps now the only road back to your HOME COUNTRY.
reading_story: Ho booms "ho-ho-hooome!" as his sleigh crosses the last border — even Santa gets misty flying over his HOME COUNTRY.

story: A SON pounds up the Staircase Curb propped against the Still Butte's right flank, shouting his name at every step, while the butte stands utterly still, refusing to budge.
reading_story: Rowe drags his SON onto the dirtiest job site, presses a shovel into the boy's hands: "Every SON earns his keep."
issues: Keyword motivation thin: nothing in the scene makes the climber specifically a SON rather than a boy/name/climb cue — consider tying the shouting to claiming the family line/inheritance.
Interference risk with 限 (same Still Butte + mound-radical actor pair, mirrored layout); differentiation rests only on the 'right flank' placement detail.
'Shouting his name at every step' is auditory filler more than a visual anchor; a striking visual (e.g., carving his name into each step) would raise imageability.

story: The Castle Gate swings both heavy doors wide — but beyond the threshold there is no courtyard: the stone gateway itself climbs upward, arch stacked upon arch, into a dizzying TOWER.
reading_story: Knuckles shadow-boxes up every spiral flight of the TOWER, and his final uppercut rings the great bell at its peak.
issues: Minor: reading_story places keyword TOWER mid-sentence rather than at an edge; meaning story satisfies the placement gate with terminal TOWER, so non-blocking
Minor: meaning-story pivot relies on a negation ("there is no courtyard") which is slightly less picturable than a positive image

story: The Terraced Hill rises on the left; at its foot the Cartwheel rolls round and round in a tight circle, stamping a ring of deep ruts into the mud — the perimeter of a CAMP.
reading_story: Jin pitches his tent dead-center in the CAMP and sings reveille; the whole army snaps into ranks just to hear him.
issues: Non-blocking: registry image for ⻖ describes the hill 'rising on the right edge' but the story stages it on the left — this matches 陣's actual layout (⻖ is the left radical), so it is correct for spatial fidelity; flags a registry-image wording inconsistency, not a story defect.
Non-blocking: reading story's 'army snaps into ranks' edges toward 軍 (army) imagery — mild interference risk with other Cartwheel military kanji, though 'ranks' is a listed meaning of 陣.

story: Twin Pillars stand at attention atop Muddy Boar, who marches them up the Terraced Hill's zigzag path — this absurd three-piece column is the entire REGIMENT.
reading_story: Ty storms the parade ground swinging his bat, and the whole REGIMENT snaps to attention saluting the batting champ.

story: The Terraced Hill looms hard on your left, its earth-ledges slumping one by one across the zigzag footpath, burying every step up to the village — perfectly placed to HINDER you.
reading_story: The Showman drags hurdles into the circus ring before every act, booming "Shoooow!" — his own obstacles HINDER the performers he introduces.
issues: Position clash with registry/corpus: story stages Terraced Hill 'hard on your left' while the ⻖ registry image says 'rising on the right edge' and shipped precedent (院, n4-mnemonics.json: 'On the right rises the Terraced Hill') follows the registry. The candidate matches 障's real glyph layout (阝 left-side), so this looks like a registry-text error, but cross-card consistency should be reconciled.
Reading story keyword is payoff of the final clause but not the literal last word ('HINDER the performers he introduces') — acceptable since the meaning story ends on HINDER, noted for tightening.

Distinctiveness pressure within the Terraced Hill family: 限 (blocked at summit = LIMIT) and 防 (terraces catch flood = WARD OFF) already use hill-blocks-passage scenes; 障's collapsing-ledges mechanism differentiates but interference risk warrants watching when 阻/妨 are authored.

story: Falling Katana slashes down across the Horizon Line; beneath them the Sealed Clam-Locket clamps tighter shut in fright. Perched at the right, the Stumpy Sparrow puffs his chest, claiming the slash as his own — pure MASCULINE swagger.
reading_story: Yuna lands a quad, then flexes both biceps at the judges — the crowd roars at her boldly MASCULINE victory pose.

story: A Pot Lid slams down on the Trap Pit, pinching the Tucked Haunch curled beneath it; the Stumpy Sparrow gripping the pit's right rim rips its stubby tail loose and flutters free — DETACH!
reading_story: With one crisp chop, Lee makes the handcuffs DETACH from his wrists and kicks them across the dojo.
issues: Minor (non-blocking): 'rips its stubby tail loose' does not state what the tail was caught on — implying the lid pinned the tail would make the detach mechanism fully explicit.
Minor (non-blocking): four actors in a single frame is at the busy-ness ceiling; acceptable here because each has a distinct spatial anchor (top lid, pit, haunch beneath, right rim).

story: You drop a single sound down a marble canyon; it hits the floor, bounces wall to wall, and climbs back up multiplied into a booming ECHO.
reading_story: Kyo, the howling rock frontman, screams into the empty arena; the ECHO screams back, and he bows to it like a duet partner.
issues: Minor: the dropped 'sound' has no concrete visible form (e.g. a glowing note or orb), so the learner must invent the falling object — small imageability cost.
Minor: in the reading_story the keyword ECHO sits mid-clause rather than at start/end; acceptable since meaning_placement gates the meaning story, but a terminal placement would land harder.
